days.source: The length of the range for the Cloudflare numbers, the PostHog numbers, and the Search Console impressions.

catalogPages.source: Qafiyah API totals on 2026-10-23: 334,248 poems + 17,340 poets + 218 feeling, meter, rhyme, theme, and collection pages.

poems.source: Qafiyah API total of poems on 2026-10-23.

poets.source: Qafiyah API total of poets on 2026-10-23.

requests.source: Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API, zone qafiyah.com, httpRequests1dGroups: the sum of sum.requests from 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22.

visitors.source: PostHog Web analytics overview, Visitors, 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22, test accounts filtered out. The page shows it as the visitors.

arabVisitors.source: PostHog SQL: count(DISTINCT person_id) of $pageview events from the 22 Arab League countries (properties.$geoip_country_code), 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22. The page uses it as the base of the country shares.

pageViews.source: PostHog Web analytics overview, Page views, 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22, test accounts filtered out.

previousPageViews.source: PostHog Web analytics overview, Page views, 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-22, test accounts filtered out.

topCountries.source: PostHog SQL: count(DISTINCT person_id) of $pageview events grouped by properties.$geoip_country_code, 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22, the top 3 of the 22 Arab League countries.

searchImpressions.source: Google Search Console, Performance on Search results, export of the last 3 months: the sum of the daily Impressions in Chart.csv from 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-21.

weeklyClicks.source: The same export, Chart.csv: the daily Clicks summed into 13 weeks of 7 days, the last week ending 2026-10-21. Keep 13 weeks, because the page labels the first one three months ago.
